kissat -q -f --seed=1 --time=600 CNF PROOF (proof path must not exist; own session); sampled every 0.25 s: proof size <= 1,258,291,200 B, capture <= 16 MiB, in-flight free >= 12e9, wall <= 600+60 s, owner cancel; RSS (runner+child) every 1 s <= 6 GiB and readable; STOP registry every 5 s
accept the solver leg only on self-exit rc20 with status lines exactly ['s UNSATISFIABLE']; then hash the proof file
drat-trim CNF PROOF -i -t 1200 (same supervision, wall 1200+60 s)

UNSAT iff: checker self-exit rc0; status segments exactly ['s VERIFIED'] (split on CR and LF); 'c parsing input formula with V variables and C clauses' equals the frozen header; 'c finished parsing, read N bytes from proof file' with N == proof file bytes (checker-consumed count); no 'early EOF', 'clauses less than expected', 'trivial UNSAT', 'ERROR', 'MEMOUT', 'wrong binary prefix', 'no empty clause detected', 'NOT VERIFIED', 'TIMEOUT'; CNF and proof re-hash unchanged after the check; both children reaped with empty process groups, no quarantine, no capture overflow or reader error
anything else UNKNOWN; SAT path as above; safety defect or cancel stops all later items
proof_feed_digest_boundary: Producer side: SHA-256 and byte length of the kissat proof FILE after kissat's self exit. Consumer side: drat-trim's own count 'read N bytes from proof file' must equal that byte length; drat-trim exposes no consumer SHA, so consumer identity of bytes rests on the immutable regular file being byte-identical (SHA/length) before and after the check. CNF: frozen digest checked in memory, on disk before the solver, and after the checker; drat-trim header line must match. No FIFO or streamed payload in this route; payloads RETAINED for independent replay.
